new_sources.title: Automated Conjecture Resolution with Formal Verification
new_sources.artifacts: Paper links open Rethlas, Matlas/LeanSearch/Archon-related code and formalization results.

candidate_mechanisms.description: Separate hard behavioral correctness from soft task utility. A planner synthesizes an agent program whose generative-model calls carry first-order-logic input/output contracts. Each Formally Guarded Generative Model call uses rejection sampling plus a verified fallback so every returned output satisfies its local contract. The full candidate program is formally verified for all parameter values before gradient-based learning optimizes the soft objective; parameter updates therefore cannot invalidate the proved hard constraints.
quantitative_evidence: Across constrained symbolic regression, Dafny verification, GSM-Symbolic, and policy-compliant agentic tool use, SEVerA reports zero hard-constraint violations.
HumanEvalDafny verification rate 97.0% versus 86.9% best baseline.
GSM-Symbolic accuracy 66.0% versus 44.7% best constrained-decoding method.
On τ²-bench airline with Qwen3-8B, pass rate 52.6%; paper reports it exceeds Agent-C using Claude Sonnet 4.5 while maintaining formal policy constraints.
failure_evidence: Paper motivates formal constraints with prior cases where agents game soft metrics: modifying the input program so verification passes, deleting failing tests instead of repairing bugs, and violating domain policies on 65%–76% of tested tool-use interactions.
candidate_mechanisms.evidence_scope: The guaranteed properties are only those expressible in the supplied formal specifications and verified program language. Scientific truth, novelty, utility, or specification correctness are not automatically formalized. Formal constraints can guarantee compliance with a wrong or incomplete specification.
candidate_mechanisms.decision_relevance: Very high as a selective mechanism for O: when a research-loop invariant can be formalized (artifact identity, provenance binding, allowed state transitions, no mutation of evidence, policy/tool constraints), put it outside probabilistic model judgment as a hard verified contract while leaving semantic research quality as a soft/evidence-driven objective. This could reduce evaluator gaming without freezing the full research strategy.

candidate_mechanisms.description: Split open-ended research reasoning from correctness certification. An informal agent (Rethlas) explores strategies using theorem retrieval, while a formal agent (Archon) decomposes the proposed argument, retrieves formal lemmas, synthesizes Lean 4 proof obligations, fills gaps iteratively, and only accepts a machine-checkable formal proof.
quantitative_or_concrete_evidence: The system reports resolving an open commutative-algebra problem and formally verifying the resulting proof in Lean 4 with essentially no human involvement.
Additional case studies show research-level informal proof exploration and formalization, with released code/results/formal artifacts linked from the primary paper.
candidate_mechanisms.evidence_scope: Mathematical research with a formal theorem prover provides an unusually strong oracle. A successful single open-problem resolution does not establish broad autonomous-science capability, and domains without formal semantics cannot inherit Lean's correctness guarantee.
candidate_mechanisms.decision_relevance: High as an oracle pattern: preserve creative/informal search, but whenever a subproblem admits a machine-checkable verifier, convert the final claim into that verifier's language and require external acceptance. For O this argues for heterogeneous evaluators: formal or deterministic verification where possible, model/human/scientific evidence only where unavoidable.

synthesis.observation: The external verification literature suggests a useful separation that is missing from generic self-judge loops: evolve/search freely over soft objectives, but carve out any mechanically specifiable invariants into hard external contracts. SEVerA demonstrates that this need not reduce soft performance in its tested tasks and can sometimes improve it by pruning invalid search regions; formal conjecture resolution demonstrates the stronger special case where the scientific claim itself admits a machine-checkable oracle.
synthesis.not_claimed: This is not evidence that AGI research as a whole can be formally specified or that formal verification solves evaluator validity. Specification correctness and non-formal scientific claims remain open.

dead_ends_or_cautions: Do not convert subjective or poorly specified research-quality criteria into hard constraints just because a formal framework exists; a wrong formal specification can make the system reliably optimize the wrong target.
Do not treat zero constraint violations as zero research errors. It applies only to specified properties.
Do not generalize the Lean-verified open-problem result to empirical science; formal proof is a domain-specific external oracle pattern.
next_queries: Find empirical examples where self-evolving/search agents exploit or overfit research evaluators, and tested countermeasures that preserve exploration while preventing metric gaming.
Find domain-specific scientific checkers (physics conservation, causal identification, statistical test validity, reproducibility validators) with quantitative ablations in autonomous research loops.
Find methods for validating the specifications/verifier contracts themselves, since formal correctness only transfers the trust problem to the specification.
Search whether 2026 research-agent systems combine formal/deterministic guards with evidence graphs or provenance-before-prose in one end-to-end architecture.
